chunks: And from his instructions (peace be upon him), he instructed a contingent that he sent to the enemy.
ai.seo_question: What were the military instructions given by Imam Ali to his troops?
ai.summary: This directive, recorded in Nahj al-Balagha by Sharif al-Radi, outlines the ethical and tactical guidelines for Imam Ali’s vanguard during the Syrian campaigns, reflecting the Shia emphasis on integrating spiritual piety with military discipline. It serves as the foundational header for the 'Letter of the Commander,' establishing the Prophet’s and Imam’s model of just warfare where conduct in battle is viewed as an extension of worship.
